fixed.summary: Painting a frame judges only the nodes whose drawing may have changed (written, laid out, moved, restyled, or drawn again on their own every frame: game draws, rich text, exits, match keys, glitches, scroll fades and focus rings) and the subtrees under any that changed; every other subtree keeps last frame's commands without being compared, and a frame that keeps every tree takes last frame's list instead of copying it.
A heading's level (`<h1>`…`<h6>`, `aria-level`) reaches native screen readers through AccessKit.
